query.text: 生活助手，我听不见声音，请帮我看着火上的锅，如果水烧开了我没发现就提醒我。
query.text_en: Life assistant, I can't hear any sound. Please help me watch the pot on the stove, and remind me if the water boils and I don't notice.

annotation.text_zh: 锅里的水已经烧开了，快去看看吧。
annotation.text_en: The water is boiling, go check on it.

assistant_role_basis: 按任务归类，不代表可从画面确认设备硬件
